entries.title: Sports lesson SP-L05 (origination 2026-09-11)
entries.summary: Experience: MICH +5.5 entered after dog number restored; covered; close ~+4.5. Evidence: Lagged dog number captured +1pt vs close; positive process CLV. Learning: Lagged dog-number capture works when gate is explicit and number restores. Change: Keep conditional reopen gates on dog numbers; track number CLV separately from juice CLV.

entries.title: Sports lesson SP-L04 (origination 2026-09-09)
entries.summary: Experience: SEA −3.5 lost on exact-3 margin (13-10). Evidence: Key number 3 is fragile for −3.5 chalk; dog +3.5 covered. Learning: Key-3 half-point favorite (−3.5) is fragile — prefer +3.5 dog side or require stronger MoS. Change: NFL key-number screen: −3.5 chalk needs extra MoS; default prefer buying +3.5 when near fair.

entries.title: Sports lesson SP-L02 (origination 2026-09-12)
entries.summary: Experience: PIT ML with Skenes: ace left ahead; Soto blew 8th; CHC 4-3. Evidence: SP thesis held early; bullpen/leverage decided ML. entries.title: Sports lesson SP-L01 (origination 2026-09-12)
entries.summary: Experience: CLE ML shadowed despite Espino thin-sample flag; MIN won 4-3. Evidence: Thin SP n was already a named kill/concern and still logged as keeper; loss followed.
